fact: A request for expressions of interest published 11 November 2025 seeks a consultant to renew Somalia's existing National ICT Policy and Strategy (2019-2024) as a 2025-2029 policy and strategy, so the earlier one's period has ended and no successor was yet in place.
title: Request for Expressions of Interest: National ICT Policy and Strategy for (2025-2029), SO-MOCT-FGS-518738-CS-CQS
publisher: Ministry of Communications and Technology, Federal Republic of Somalia (EA-RDIP, World Bank)
